rickshaw-puller-and-coin: Twenty Paise, oil and charcoal by Dr Dolly Prasad: a rickshaw puller seen from behind, a red cloth over his shoulders, holds the shafts in front of a giant embossed 20 paise coin.
carriage-and-autorickshaw: Aakhri Savaari, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a grey horse stands ready at a tonga with a man seated under its orange-red hood, beside an auto drawn in white line on maroon.
bullock-cart-and-truck: Dheere Dheere, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a driver raises a stick over a grey bullock and a cart of sacks, beside an orange truck lettered Public Tata Carrier on navy.
rickshaw-rest-framed: Ek Rupaya, oil and charcoal by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in a white kurta sits on a rickshaw with a red wheel and looks back over his shoulder, in front of a huge coin marked rupaya.
coins-and-clay-bank: Gullak, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a terracotta coin bank with a slot on top, among old Indian coins that include a half anna of 1946 and five naye paise of 1963.
postbox-and-stamps: Patra Petika, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a red pillar box lettered in Hindi with a New Delhi pin code, against a wall of old Indian stamps, several showing Gandhi.
mother-india-and-kettles: Mother India, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: four steel kettles fall in a cascade down the left side of a red poster for the film Mother India that shows a woman's face.
shree-420-and-milk-cans: Shree 420, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: three dented, rusted milk cans and a torn white Maratha Mandir poster for Shree 420 with Raj Kapoor and Nargis, on a red ground.
bulls-and-wheel: Before the Engines, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: two yoked bullocks with blue and green horns, a brass bell at each neck and a zigzag cloth over one back, by a red wheel.
cycle-rickshaw: Last of the Pedals, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a shirtless man with a cycle rickshaw, a white cloth on his shoulder, against Ambassador cars, autos and a bus in dark red.
rickshaw-rest: Thodi Der, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in a white kurta and dhoti crouches on the footboard of a hand-pulled rickshaw, a small brass bell hanging from his hand.
horse-cart-and-autorickshaw: A Ride Together, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a horse cart with a turbaned driver and three passengers in a sepia panel of buildings, beside a teal and yellow auto on red.
rickshaw-and-autorickshaw: Guzra Zamana, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in a dhoti, painted in sepia, holds the shafts of a rickshaw carrying a seated passenger, beside a teal and yellow auto.
terracotta-pots: Kadhai, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a heap of copper kadhais and pots lying at every angle, their surface heavily textured, on a dark brown ground.
weathered-door-ring: Bandh Darwaze I, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: weathered grey door planks with a red ring knocker on a green plate and a small barred window in an ornate iron frame.
red-and-teal-door-lock: Bandh Darwaze II, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a rusted padlock through a rusted hasp on grey wood, with red paint flaking off and the teal frame worn.
teal-door-bolt: Bandh Darwaze III, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a padlocked bolt runs through riveted staples across the join of two door leaves, teal paint patchy over brown wood.
carved-door-knocker: Bandh Darwaze IV, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a dark iron heart-shaped door handle and three round studs with turquoise flower centres, on orange wood flecked with turquoise.
monks-and-blue-buddha: Dhyan, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a huge blue Buddha face, eyes shut, above four monks, two with eyes closed, one reading loose pages and one with his back to us.
monk-and-green-buddha: Sharan, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a monk in an orange robe, his back to us and his face pressed into joined palms, in front of a green Buddha with a yellow halo.
offering-of-light: Vakratunda, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a boy with a shaved head raises a lit diya on a plate in front of tablets of the Vakratunda verse and small Ganesh drawings.
prayer-and-scripture: Gayatri, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a bare-backed man sits with his back to us in front of tablets lettered with the Gayatri mantra and a brass lamp stand.
priest-with-flame: Aarti, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a priest seen from behind, in a white dhoti and shawl, raises a flaming aarti lamp in one hand and holds a brass bell low in the other.
sacred-tree: Mannat, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a grey peepal trunk wrapped in a broad band of red, orange and white thread, and a garlanded trident and a small red shrine at its base.
newspaper-reader: Morning Ritual, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: an elderly man with a tilak and a white beard, bare-chested in a dhoti, holds up a Hindi daily newspaper against an ochre wall.
elder-woman-portrait: Sabr, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: an old woman with grey hair, three white stripes and a red dot on her forehead and a nose stud looks straight out at us.
red-turban-portrait: Muskaan, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in a red turban smiles with his head tilted down and his eyes crinkled almost shut, grey stubble and a gold flower earring.
yellow-turban-portrait: Garv, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in a large yellow turban, face turned slightly away and eyes on us, with a grey beard, pressed lips and deep forehead lines.
patterned-turban-portrait: Fikr, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man in an orange turban with a cream lattice, brow furrowed and lower lip pushed out, looks down and to the left.
mother-and-child: Aanchal, oil and charcoal by Dr Dolly Prasad: a mother in a white sari with a red border looks down while the boy beside her holds her forearm and looks straight at us.
boy-and-kettle: Bachpan, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a boy painted in blue rests his chin in his hand by a rusted tin stove, next to a blue kettle with steam rising from its spout.
man-among-metal-pans: Intezar, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a man seen from behind, in a pale turban and a white shawl with a blue stripe, sits among empty kadhais, deep black iron pans.
three-veiled-women: Lajja, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: three women in red veils with no faces showing, in yellow-orange blouses and bangles, one arm raised over the group.
milkman-on-bicycle: Before the Chai, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a milkman in a red turban, seen from behind, rides a bicycle down a blue road with steel milk cans hanging on both sides.
riverside-figures: Evening at the Ghat, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: figures in white and saffron wraps sit on riverside steps under large woven cane umbrellas, above dark water.
child-among-flowers: Blooming Innocence, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a girl with long dark hair, her hand over her mouth, looks to the side among red, orange and pink bougainvillea.
woman-with-poppies: Khwaab, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a woman among large poppies, a yellow poppy in front of her gaze and faded maroon poppies behind her.
temple-bells: Threads of Faith, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: brass bells and thick bunches of red, orange and pink thread hang from bamboo rails, with Ram written on the wall.
woman-with-bird: Whispers of Stillness, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a woman in profile with long black hair, a red-orange bird with a blue head at her shoulder, among protea-like flowers.
woman-with-red-flower: Petals of Thought, oil and pastel by Dr Dolly Prasad: a woman with black hair over half her face looks toward a large red flower near her lips, a fingertip under her eye.
boy-with-bananas: Under Canopy of Greens, oil on canvas by Dr Dolly Prasad: a boy in an orange flower-print shirt steadies bananas on his head and smiles at us under dark green banana leaves.
